email.subject: Summit Ridge Construction Inc. — Mid-term policy change request for CPP-6612078
email.body:
Good morning,

Please process an endorsement on behalf of Summit Ridge Construction Inc. under policy CPP-6612078. We are requesting a mid-term change effective 02/01/2026.

Requested change: add a service vehicle to the commercial auto exposure and update the policy to reflect the revised operating schedule.

Please issue the endorsement and confirm once completed. If you need any supporting documentation, let me know.

Thank you,
Derek Olsson

schedule_rows.label: Change Item
schedule_rows.value: Add Vehicle: 2024 Ford F-150 XL, VIN 1FTFW1E50RKD12345, Garaged at 9400 E Arapahoe Rd, Centennial, CO 80112

schedule_rows.label: Coverage
schedule_rows.value: Business Auto Liability and Physical Damage

provisions: Paragraph B.7. is amended to include the vehicle described in the Schedule above as a covered auto for purposes of Business Auto Liability when used in the course of the named insured's operations.

The Autos Covered By This Policy provision is amended to apply Physical Damage coverage to the specifically described auto shown in the Schedule above, subject to the terms, conditions, deductibles, and valuation basis applicable to such coverage.

The Schedule of Covered Autos You Own is amended to reflect the addition of the above vehicle effective on the endorsement date shown, and any premium adjustment required by this change shall be charged or returned in accordance with company rating rules.
All other terms and conditions of this policy remain unchanged.
documents.change_description: Adds one specifically described service vehicle to the policy effective 02/01/2026.
